title: Dark Corridor of Glowing Doors Video
prompt: I want to create a video where I am standing in a dark corridor lined with doors. I stand there knocking on the door directly in front of me; yet, every time I knock, a different door opens, radiating light that draws my gaze. I remain standing before that same original door, knocking again, only for another door to open, shining with an intense glow. Some of these doors reveal breathtaking natural landscapes, yet the door I am actually knocking on remains firmly shut, leaving me to sink to the ground in despair.
